package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/target"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/wasm/installation"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/runner"
)

type request struct {
	Operation, Installation, WorkingDir, Kind, Source, Output, Plan, Artifacts string
	Arguments, BuildTags, Shards                                               []string
	Index, Count                                                               uint64
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(3)
	}
}

func run() error {
	var input request
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&input); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	description, err := installation.Resolve(installation.Spec{ExplicitManifest: input.Installation})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	provider, err := description.Provider()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	const build = "gomad.frozen-campaign-api-reference/v1"
	var result any
	switch input.Operation {
	case "plan":
		result, err = runner.CreateCampaignPlan(ctx, runner.CampaignPlanSpec{Output: input.Output, Campaign: runner.CampaignSpec{
			Backend: provider, Strategy: runner.StrategySeed, Seeds: "8,7", Parallel: 1,
			ExecutionTimeout: 30 * time.Second, OverallTimeout: 10 * time.Minute, TerminateGrace: 2 * time.Second,
			OnFailure: runner.PolicyAll, FailureBudget: 1, OutputLimit: 8 << 20, WorldTransitionLimit: 64 << 20,
			ChoiceTraceLimit: 8 << 20, IOTranscriptLimit: 64 << 20, Artifacts: input.Artifacts, RunnerBuild: build,
			KeepSuccesses: runner.KeepSuccessesAll, SuccessArtifactLimit: 8, SuccessBytesLimit: 256 << 20,
			Target: target.Spec{Backend: "wasm", Kind: target.Kind(input.Kind), Source: input.Source,
				Args: input.Arguments, BuildTags: input.BuildTags, WorkingDir: input.WorkingDir, CapabilityMode: target.CapabilityModeClosure},
		}})
	case "execute-shard":
		var campaign runner.CampaignResult
		campaign, err = runner.RunCampaignShard(ctx, runner.CampaignShardSpec{Backend: provider, PlanPath: input.Plan,
			Shard: runner.CampaignShard{Index: input.Index, Count: input.Count}, Artifacts: input.Artifacts, RunnerBuild: build})
		result = campaign
		if err == nil && campaign.Failures != 0 {
			if encodeErr := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result); encodeErr != nil {
				return encodeErr
			}
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	case "merge":
		result, err = runner.MergeCampaignShards(ctx, runner.CampaignMergeSpec{PlanPath: input.Plan, Shards: input.Shards, Output: input.Output})
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported fixture operation %q", input.Operation)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result)
}
